Close a workspace binding. A convergence this server is following on it is detached, never cancelled: it gives back the state lock and waits in the engine, where a later `open` reports it and apply takes it up again. Nothing in the configuration or the state is touched.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
